author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Ring Broadcast v1.1 (Zephyr rate integration + seed_tools shim)
abstract: Aligns adaptive controller with Zephyr’s AdaptiveSampler by mapping p_send to ctrl.rate and updating it via adjust_rate per coverage delta; adds a compatibility shim so `import seed_tools` works. Produces aggregates and stores a JSON report.
